notes.subject: אלהים
notes.rationale: ciraɲɛmɔgɔ la: 'Elohim ye, i ka atara' (KJ/BSB) walima Yuda-sigidi ta: 'i ka atara min Elohim di a ma' (JPS 'given of God').

notes.subject: ⟨Elohim ye⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan ma cira-daɲɛ sɛbɛn; Bamanankan ka kan ka a jira walasa kuma ka faamu.

notes.subject: שבט … שבט
notes.rationale: daɲɛ fila-fila-ɲagami: 'dɔgɔkɔrɔ … kibaru' — Bamanankan ma se ka a jira ni daɲɛ kelen ye.

translation: I ka atara, ⟨Elohim ye⟩, bɛna taalen don ka bɔ san kɔnɔ ka taa san kɔnɔ; dɔgɔkɔrɔ min bɛ mara ɲɛfɔ, o ye i ka masaya kibaru ye.
